create_accumulate_updates: create an Update object to accumulate and overwrite previous updates during long computations
build_addable_updates: build an AddableUpdate to combine objects using the + operator with in-place accumulation
create_indexed_list_updates: create a ListUpdate to maintain a list with indexed positions for sparse result assembly
test_nested_list_updates: test ListUpdate with nested ListUpdate payloads to assemble multi-dimensional results
summarize_update_to_result: summarize accumulated updates into a final result using to_result or to_simplified_result methods
